title: Potpourri
description: Adds in little details, such as item variants depending on where you found the item or how you crafted it.
body:
# Potpourri
It's the small details that count, and Potpourri takes that to heart.

## What does Potpourri add?
Potpourri aims to add more small details here and there that aren't really needed, like extra paintings, item variants, or small structures.

Potpourri currently adds 142 item variants, 3 armor trims, one structure, 2 paintings, and one new damage type.

<details>
<summary>List of Features</summary>

Item Variants

- Tool variants for most stone and wood types (135 Total)

- Mossy, Pale Mossy, Wither, Sculk, and Arrow bone variants

  - 2 Bone Arrows can be crafted with one Bone and one Flint and function just like regular arrows. However, a stack can only hold up to 16.

- Invisible Item Frames can now be crafted with one Item Frame and one Glass Pane (Can be done with Glow Item Frames too!)

3 Armor Trims

- Eyes armor trim, based on the Creaking

  - Made using Chiseled Resin Bricks

- Rabbit armor trim, based on rabbits.

  - Made using Rabbit's Foot

- Profit armor trim, found in blacksmith chests

  - Made using Deepslate Emerald Ore

Structures

- Pale Hut Structure

  - Found rarely in Pale Garden

2 Paintings

- Four Pointer - A drawing of a star

- Island - A drawing of an island floating in space

Misc Features

- Stonecutters now hurt to stand on

  - New Damage type, includes new death messages

</details>

Expect updates as often as my brain comes up with new ideas, which may be incredibly slow, or reasonably often.

## ˅ ˅ ˅ Important! ˅ ˅ ˅
Please note that as a datapack this this may not be compatible with some mods!

You are required to download [the resource pack!](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/potpourri-resources) (Unless you install the mod version)
